name: Mahamri
steps: Mix flour, sugar, yeast, cardamom and salt. Add coconut milk and knead 8 minutes to a smooth soft dough.
Cover and let rise about 90 minutes until doubled. Divide into four balls, roll each to a 15 cm circle and cut each circle into four triangles.
After rising, gently press the dough to release large air pockets; keep it soft as you divide it so the triangles can puff.
Heat oil to 170°C. Fry triangles in batches, turning, for 3–4 minutes until puffed and golden. Drain and serve warm with tea.
tips: Do not reroll scraps repeatedly; overworked dough makes dense mahamri.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
